regime_context: China A-shares show a narrow, one-narrative rotation led by Coal, with Banks as a crowding-flagged challenger. The backtest verdict is explicit that the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold here (mean-reverting tape) and gate_helps is false, so the only validated edge is absent for this market — all leans must be expressed as low-conviction conditionals, not forecasts.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Coal's leadership handoff to Banks CONFIRMS: Coal score 0.8 vs Banks 0.757 with margin 0.043 is too close to call a handoff yet. I am watching for Banks to take rank 1 while Coal's score rolls below 0.7 AND Banks' crowding_z falls below 1.0 (absorption rising above 0.5). If Coal widens its margin back above 0.2 and Banks' crowding_z stays above 1.5, this watch retires as no handoff.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal leads the detector ranks and is the only scorable theme that is eligible and NOT crowded, with absorption moderate and a one-narrative structure. The lean is a trend-persistence continuation conditional, not an alpha claim: IF leadership holds (score does not roll over) AND breadth improves from 0.3, THEN overweight is justified. Absolute-trend gate history says this market whipsaws, so the gate_direction risk is real.
theses.dissent: Coal is a mean-reverting, policy-driven Chinese commodity theme with low breadth (0.3) and mixed Hurst — the history shows this market's trend gate whipsaws, so a continuation call is precisely where this tape tends to disappoint.

falsifier.text: Coal ETF 515220.SS closes below its 20-day moving average and loses its rank-1 position to Banks before the check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are rank 2, eligible, with the highest durability_bar (0.82) and strongest breadth (0.833) in the eligible set, suggesting a more cohesive trend than Coal. But the crowding flag (z=1.83) and the AI directive to never treat crowding as a buy make this a size-down continuation candidate, not a chase. Lean is conditional on crowding not causing a stall.
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded (z nearly +2 sigma) which historically marks attention tops in China; the ranks say momentum focus, not return forecast, and the crowd is already in.

falsifier.text: Bank ETF 512800.SS underperforms CSI 300 by 3% over a rolling 10-day window while SOE Blue Chips or Coal take the leadership rank

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Innovative Pharma & CXO is scorable, eligible, but score is negative (-0.135) with crowded flag true and mixed Hurst. The underweight lean reflects the detector's own 'eligible but negative score' signal plus crowding — a de-risk posture, not a short. Only the absolute-trend gate history (which did not hold here) makes this a true caution-lean rather than an avoid.
evidence: eligible true, but score below zero
theses.dissent: Negative momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha; pharma CXO could mean-revert sharply if any policy easing headline hits, and the discretionary 'underweight' on a crowded but durable theme is exactly the reflexive fade the guardrails warn against.

falsifier.text: Pharma CXO ETF 159992.SZ rallies 5% relative to CSI 300 and its score turns positive while not crowded before the check-by date
